statements.text: The eRulings Template is reserved exclusively for the electronic submission of initial binding ruling requests to the NCSD in New York.
Under the newly enhanced eRulings program, the importing community may submit an electronic request for a binding ruling by accessing the new eRulings Template.

The procedures under this rulings program apply to requests for binding classification rulings under the Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) and certain marking, origin, NAFTA and applicability of Trade Program rulings.
CBP's Electronic Ruling (eRuling) Template - Allows you to transmit an electronic binding ruling request.
The template permits the online filing of an electronic binding ruling request directly to the National Commodity Specialist Division (NCSD) of Regulations and Rulings.

The Binding Ruling Program enables importers and other interested parties to get binding pre-entry classification decisions prior to importing a product and filing entries with Customs and Border Protection (CBP).
Classification rulings determine which Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) provisions apply to your goods. The HTS number determines the applicable duty rate and eligibility for various trade programs.
Tariff Classifications are binding, however duty rates are not.

The importer submits either an electronic ruling request or a letter describing the product in detail and provides a sample to the CBP Information Exchange, National Commodity Specialist for a ruling.
